Oracle Financial Services Software
Associate Consultant - Application Support (Mumbai)

Job Description
Oracle Financial Services Software (OFSS) is a world leader in providing IT solutions to the financial services industry.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide L2 production support for core banking applications built on Oracle FLEXCUBE.
- Perform root cause analysis of incidents and follow ITIL incident management processes.
- Write and tune PL/SQL queries on Oracle Database.
- Work on Linux servers and write shell scripts to automate routine tasks.
- Communicate with clients and stakeholders on issue status.

Requirements
- 0-2 years of experience; freshers with strong fundamentals may apply.
- Working knowledge of SQL and Oracle Database.
- Good command of Java or any object oriented programming language.
- Basic understanding of computer networking (TCP/IP, HTTP).
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Good to Have
- Knowledge of the banking domain and financial services.
- Exposure to Unix operating system concepts.
